name: SS Threaded Fittings Class 150
desc: Stainless steel screwed fittings rated Class 150 for water, air and light process lines. Stocked from ¼″ to 6″: 45° and 90° elbows, tees, sockets, unions, hex nipples, end caps and plugs, plus reducer sockets and reducer bushes from ¼″ × ½″ to 4″ × 3″.
specs: Elbows (45° / 90°), tees, sockets, unions, hex nipples, end caps, plugs, reducer sockets, reducer bushes

name: Long Barrel Nipples (GI, SS & MS)
desc: Long barrel nipples threaded at both ends, for joining female-threaded fittings, valves and equipment. ¼″ to 6″ in 12″ lengths, in galvanized iron, stainless steel and mild steel, seamless or ERW to suit the job.

name: Butterfly Valves (CI & SS)
desc: Wafer and lug butterfly valves for water, HVAC and general service, 1½″ to 12″, lever or gear operated. Choose full stainless steel, cast iron body with stainless steel disc, or cast iron body with ductile iron disc.
specs: SS / SS · CI / SS · CI / DI

name: Safety Valves
desc: Safety and pressure relief valves to protect boilers, receivers, compressors and pressurised lines. Tell us the size, connection and set pressure and we'll confirm what's available.
specs: On request: size, connection and set pressure

name: Y-Strainers
desc: Y-strainers catch scale and debris before it reaches pumps, meters, control valves and steam traps. ½″ to 12″ with flanged (PN16, Class 150–600), threaded, socket-weld or butt-weld ends, in cast iron, cast steel, stainless steel and brass.
specs: Cast iron · cast steel · stainless steel · brass

name: Spiral Wound Gaskets
desc: Semi-metallic gaskets for high-pressure and high-temperature flanges: a V-shaped stainless steel strip wound with graphite or PTFE filler, with a solid outer ring for centring and controlled compression. Inner rings are available for severe service. ½″ to 24″.
specs: Outer centring ring; inner ring optional

name: SS Angles, Channels & Flat Bars
desc: Stainless steel structural sections for frames, brackets, supports, trims and fabrication: equal and unequal angles, C-channels and flat bars.
specs: Equal and unequal angles, C-channels, flat bars

name: SS Round Bars
desc: Stainless steel round bar for shafts, pins, fasteners, machined parts and general fabrication.

name: GI Sheets
desc: Galvanized steel sheet for ducting, cladding, enclosures, cable trays and general fabrication.

name: SS Decorative & Structural Tubes
desc: Welded stainless steel tube to ASTM A554 / JIS G3446 for railings, furniture, frames, exhausts and fabrication. Round tube from 13.7 mm to 323.9 mm OD with walls from 0.7 mm to 6.5 mm; square and rectangular hollow sections also available.
